# Cleanup Tencent TCR tags

Reusable GitHub composite action for Tencent Personal Container Registry repositories.

The action lists tags through `DescribeImagePersonal`, sorts them by push/update/creation time, and removes old tags through `BatchDeleteImagePersonal`.

Required environment variables:

- `TENCENTCLOUD_SECRET_ID`
- `TENCENTCLOUD_SECRET_KEY`
- `TCR_REPO_NAME`, for example `namespace/repository`

Optional environment variables:

- `TCR_REGION`, defaults to `ap-hongkong`
- `TCR_KEEP_TAGS`, defaults to `50`
- `TCR_CLEANUP_DRY_RUN`, set to `true` to only print deletions
- `TCR_API_ENDPOINT`, defaults to `tcr.tencentcloudapi.com`

The Tencent Cloud API key needs permissions for:

- `tcr:DescribeImagePersonal`
- `tcr:BatchDeleteImagePersonal`

The cleanup action fails the build when either API credential is missing or the
Tencent API request fails. This is intentional: silently skipping cleanup can
leave the repository at the 100-tag limit and make the subsequent image push
fail.

Call this action before pushing an image so a full free repository cannot block the new push. Reserve enough tag capacity for all tags generated by the build.
